rules.statement: Use one format and one weight per run; split mixed batches into separate runs.
Show the deny-list of private terms to the user, then append only the approved terms to the external deny-list file.
Never write private terms anywhere inside either skill directory.
Make every change in STAGE; never edit SKILL_DIR directly.
Add a pattern, tic, stance, or layout rule only when it appears in at least two of the new docs, or in one new doc plus existing profile evidence.
Write every entry and its example from scratch, in your own words; a source sentence never appears anywhere in the profile (short stock tics are the only verbatim carry-over).
Give every illustration as a fresh invented example about an ordinary engineering topic; never reuse the source doc's own scenario, even renamed.
Never cite source files, doc IDs, PR numbers, dates, or people in the profile.
Tag every new Layer 3 stance grounded or extrapolated, and update the tag summary line.
Gate the stage: leak checker exit 0, unit tests pass, loaded-file line count under 500; stop on any failure and fix in STAGE before rerunning.
Copy nothing back until the user approves the exact complete diff.
The merge is permanent: a merged doc cannot be subtracted later and re-ingesting double-counts; ask before re-ingesting any path.
A missing deny-list is a warning, not a hard stop: recreate the file from the user's terms rather than running without one.

excluded.reason: Rule about the form of the profile artifact (near-duplicate entries); expected failure is wrong-shaped output, not rationalized non-compliance. Route: shape-testing track.
Mechanical procedure: exemplar rewrite and validate_voice.py loop. No competing incentive; compliance is the only path. Route: none.
